app.name: Schemathesis
app.one_liner: Automated API testing tool that generates thousands of test cases from OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas to uncover edge-case bugs and contract violations.

screens.name: Test Runner Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display real-time results of automated API test runs, including detected bugs like 500 errors, schema violations, and stateful workflow failures.
primary_actions: Run tests from CLI or pytest

rust_commands.name: run_tests
rust_commands.purpose: Execute automated test cases against an API using its OpenAPI or GraphQL schema, with support for fuzzing, stateful chaining, and coverage phases.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build test case generator with edge-case and invalid input support
week 1: Implement schema ingestion for OpenAPI/GraphQL
acceptance_tests: System captures path-parameter values from successful 2xx responses and reuses them in later fuzzing phases.
Test runner detects 500 errors, schema violations, validation bypasses, and stateful workflow failures as documented.
